notes.content: Students must complete a minimum of 120 units of academic work in order to earn the Bachelor of Science in bioengineering. Students must also adhere to the University’s graduation requirements for bachelor's degrees. A total of 45 units of engineering coursework is required and Cooperative Education is optional.

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit.

Writing
